_doc: The Tern's shield faces and presets (openspec/changes/weapons-and-shields section 9; coop-drill design 2.2). Faces in order: bow (+Z), stern (-Z), port (+X), starboard (-X), dorsal (+Y), ventral (-Y). Every preset sums to the 240 MJ capacity; each face is held to 15-80 MJ. Regeneration is 0.25 x the generator's 12 MW, shared by the preset's caps. The ellipsoid envelops the whole ship (owner, 2026-10-14: shield should envolop the ship entirely; console-ship-model 3): the smallest axis-aligned ellipsoid that holds every vertex of the exterior model, assets/models/exteriors/tern.glb, with 1 m to spare (tools/ships/console_model.py --check holds it), and it decides the face a hit strikes (sc-core shield_face). frequency is weapons-and-shields 11's: a face loses match_factor of a hit whose weapon band matches the shield's, and retune_factor while the shield retunes for retune_s.
